name: kairos-fixed-rate-borrow
description: Quotes Kairos fixed-rate USDC and USDT borrows on Aave V3 (Ethereum) by term, including the protocol fee, utilization fee, risk premium, and early-exit penalty. Opens the loan, locks an existing Aave borrow, repays Aave, and closes the Kairos swap. Each write returns one group sign request.
